questions.q: In a triangle, the angles are in the ratio $2 : 3 : 5$. What is the measure of the largest angle?
questions.answer: Total parts $= 2 + 3 + 5 = 10$. The sum of angles in a triangle is $180^\circ$. One part $= \frac{180}{10} = 18^\circ$. The largest angle $= 5 \times 18 = 90^\circ$.

questions.q: In a right triangle, one leg is $12\text{ cm}$ and the hypotenuse is $13\text{ cm}$. What is the area of the triangle?
questions.answer: By Pythagorean triple $5-12-13$, the second leg is $\sqrt{13^2 - 12^2} = 5\text{ cm}$. Area $= \frac{1}{2} \times 12 \times 5 = 30\text{ cm}^2$.

questions.q: Two parallel lines are intersected by a transversal. If an interior angle measures $(3x - 15)^\circ$ and its consecutive interior angle measures $(2x + 20)^\circ$, what is $x$?
questions.answer: Consecutive interior angles are supplementary: $(3x - 15) + (2x + 20) = 180 \Rightarrow 5x + 5 = 180 \Rightarrow 5x = 175 \Rightarrow x = 35$.

questions.q: A circle has a circumference of $16\pi\text{ cm}$. What is its area?
questions.answer: Circumference $= 2\pi r = 16\pi \Rightarrow r = 8\text{ cm}$. Area $= \pi r^2 = \pi (8^2) = 64\pi\text{ cm}^2$.

questions.q: A square of side length $10\text{ cm}$ has a circle inscribed within it. What is the area of the shaded region between the square and the circle?
questions.answer: Square area $= 10^2 = 100$. The inscribed circle diameter is $10$, so $r = 5$, and circle area $= \pi(5^2) = 25\pi$. Shaded area $= 100 - 25\pi$.

questions.q: If the radius of a circle is doubled, by what factor does its area increase?
questions.answer: Area is proportional to $r^2$. Doubling the radius multiplies the area by $2^2 = 4$.

questions.q: A rectangle has a perimeter of $40\text{ cm}$ and its length is $3$ times its width. What is the area of the rectangle?
questions.answer: Perimeter $= 2(l + w) = 40 \Rightarrow l + w = 20$. Since $l = 3w$, we have $4w = 20 \Rightarrow w = 5$, and $l = 15$. Area $= 15 \times 5 = 75\text{ cm}^2$.

questions.q: What is the sum of the interior angles of a regular hexagon?
questions.answer: Formula for sum of interior angles: $(n - 2) \times 180^\circ$. For a hexagon ($n = 6$): $(6 - 2) \times 180 = 4 \times 180 = 720^\circ$.

questions.q: A rhombus has diagonals of lengths $12\text{ cm}$ and $16\text{ cm}$. What is the length of one side of the rhombus?
questions.answer: The diagonals bisect each other at right angles into half-lengths of $6\text{ cm}$ and $8\text{ cm}$. By the Pythagorean theorem: $\text{Side} = \sqrt{6^2 + 8^2} = \sqrt{100} = 10\text{ cm}$.

questions.q: A rectangular tank has dimensions $4\text{ m} \times 5\text{ m} \times 6\text{ m}$. If it is filled with water at a rate of $10\text{ m}^3/\text{min}$, how many minutes does it take to fill completely?
A cylinder has base radius $3\text{ cm}$ and height $10\text{ cm}$. What is its volume in cubic centimeters?
If the volume of a cube is $64\text{ cm}^3$, what is its total surface area?
questions.answer: Side length $s = \sqrt[3]{64} = 4\text{ cm}$. Total surface area $= 6s^2 = 6(4^2) = 6 \times 16 = 96\text{ cm}^2$.
